text:
Rina (Finance): We have a late vendor charge for March that arrived this morning for $62,310.18. Service period is 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31. Do we treat as a March prior-period adjustment or accrue in April? @Sam (Audit) @Devon (Billing)

invoice-bot: Invoice #493400 uploaded: https://invoices.redwood.local/493400. Invoice date 2026-04-02. Service: 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31. Amount: $62,310.18.

Devon (Billing): ETL backfill from our usage pipeline — most of the dollars are for one account (ATLANTIS-3). Quick extract: ATLANTIS-3,2026-03-30,24_500_000 tokens,$58,200.00; misc smaller accounts total $4,110.18. No duplicates.

Jon (RevenueOps): Matching principle favors March recognition. Proposed: post prior-period JE to move AR into Deferred Revenue for March, link invoice and include memo. Will amortize per existing schedule.

Sam (Audit): OK with prior-period adj if documentation attached: invoice PDF, pipeline log showing usage timestamps, and sign-offs. Also include assessment of whether this changes quarter revenue recognition or KPI pacing.

Aisha (Sales Ops): Note: ATLANTIS-3 participated in our March pricing pilot; they have an eligible retro credit of ~$7k. Sales prefers to show the credit on the April billing cycle for customer clarity. We don't want to apply the customer-facing credit retroactively on the March statement.

Rina (Finance): Suggestion: book gross invoice into March deferrals and record a Customer Credit Liability of $6,975.00. That preserves March matching and leaves the customer credit to be applied on first April invoice.

Devon (Billing): Technically straightforward. JE draft if we go gross + credit liability: Date 2026-03-31 Dr Accounts Receivable 62,310.18 / Cr Deferred Revenue 55,335.18 / Cr Customer Credit Liability 6,975.00. We'll keep a note in the customer ledger to prevent double-billing the credit.

Sam (Audit): Approve gross + credit liability. Please route the short memo to audit@redwood.com and tag the JE as "post-close prior period". Include the ETL timestamped logs and the invoice PDF.

Jon (RevenueOps): I'll update the revenue schedule and add invoice 493400 as a prior-period entry. Also flag this root cause in the close retrospective so we add an ETL SLA check.

Rina (Finance): Action items: 1) I'll draft the memo and circulate for signatures (target today EOD). 2) @Devon to prepare JE after approvals. 3) @Aisha to confirm April credit communication wording. 4) @Jon to update revenue schedule and right-size forecasts.

Devon (Billing): Got it. I'll prepare the April credit memo draft for ATLANTIS-3 and queue the JE once memo is approved.

Rina (Finance): Thanks all — moving to action. Will post memo link here when complete and then close thread.
